# Third-party assets

Downloaded for F-010 on 2026-09-21/22. Only the files under this directory are third-party assets; Cyber Town source code remains under the repository license.

## Tiny RPG Fantasy

- Author: Luis Zuno / ansimuz
- Source: https://ansimuz.itch.io/tiny-rpg-town
- Downloaded file: `tiny-rpg-town-files.zip`, itch.io upload `17130576`
- License: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal. The included `public-license.pdf` and the official asset page allow personal/commercial use, modification, and redistribution of the free assets.
- Generative AI declaration: the official asset page states that no generative AI was used.
- Used in F-010: town tiles, buildings, player and NPC sprites.
- Unused authoring-source `.ase` and `.psd` files remain in the local download but are Git-ignored; the project uses the exported PNG assets and retained license.

## Noto Sans CJK SC

- Author: Adobe and Google contributors
- Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk
- Distributable file: `noto_sans_cjk_sc_complete/NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.otf`
- SHA-256: `4D2E100498ED85AD46F3D39D1EDB5DA655FD6E0BE664EB789717D1D940EB2EDD`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1. See `noto_sans_cjk_sc_complete/LICENSE.txt`.
- The first download was interrupted and remains isolated in `noto_sans_cjk_sc/` by `.gdignore`. A later resumable download completed; the verified OpenType file begins with the `OTTO` signature and is now the Godot UI font.
